title: carranza1914 (new): message signed V. Carranza, transcribed for Pablo González on Villa and Saltillo, undated [probably May 1914] (catalogue 1465), Clave Extra 3 read in part with the key rebuilt from LXVIII-1.14.1943.1 (contributed by WAINUT)

fuentes1914 (new): A. Fuentes D. to Pablo González, Monterrey, 13 Jun [1914] (catalogue 1465), four coded runs in Clave Extra 3 read in part with the key rebuilt from LXVIII-1.14.1943.1, 11 of 13 coded words verbatim and no holes (contributed by WAINUT)

murguia1914 (new): Francisco Murguía to Pablo González, Lamadrid, 16 Mar 1914 (catalogue 1465), Clave Extra 3 read from the figures, key rebuilt from the contemporary pencil decipherment and tested on a held-out page (contributed by WAINUT)
sanchez1922 (new): [F.] Sánchez to "José González", 12 Jan 1922 (catalogue 1445, CEHM-Carso DCXXI.3.323.1), cipher words read with Narváez's published key 313, not prose (contributed by WAINUT)
duhart1921 (new): Pedro Duhart to "Vicente Gutiérrez", New York, 29 Aug 1921 (catalogue 1445, CEHM-Carso DCXXI.3.231.1), all 17 cipher runs deciphered, not prose (contributed by WAINUT)

idiaquez1577 (new): Juan de Idiáquez and Pedro de Mendoza, Genoa, to Philip II, 24 Nov 1577 (catalogue 754, AGS Estado 1410,115), cipher of images 1-2 read in part with Brice Dudout's K_P2 key applied frozen (contributed by WAINUT)
goslinga1730 (new): Goslinga to Van Reede-Ginkel, Compiègne 23 July 1730 (catalogue 2534), letter read with a key rebuilt from the contemporary slip; May 1730 page not read (contributed by WAINUT)

malen1615 (new): J. van Malen to his brother Van Malen de Bautersem, two letters (catalogue 2532), symbol cipher solved ciphertext-only; letter 1 read in part, letter 2 decoded in part (contributed by WAINUT)

blaufeldt1646 (new): a writer signing in cipher "Blaufeldt" to Ottavio Piccolomini, Giessen, [February?] 1646 (catalogue 2355), inv. 24854 read in part and the cipher signature read, key from the glossed sibling letters (contributed by WAINUT)
hopken1740 (addition): Lit. B of Diplomatica Turcica I/9/29 (catalogue 2242), a bare Latin letter signed Ibrahim Effendi, read in part with this folder's key unchanged (contributed by WAINUT)

ewsum1535 (new): cipher opening in Johan van Ewsum's register, Groninger Archieven 696 inv. 595 (catalogue 2533), read with the writer's own key: a letter on soldiers' pay and a note on a truce, not recipes (contributed by WAINUT)
pandolfini1515 (new): Francesco Pandolfini to the Otto di Pratica, Vercelli, 6 and 8 Sept 1515 (catalogue 2393), MAP CXXXVII 666 read in part with Brice Dudout's key v6 (contributed by WAINUT)

hopken1742 (new): the Khan of Crimea's letter to the King of Sweden, Constantinople 1742 (catalogue 2244), "Lit. A" in the second Höpken code, read with its contemporary gloss; held-out test of the frozen hopken1740 key on a third volume (contributed by WAINUT)
